shared_knowledge.title: 色彩构成：70-20-10 色板比例黄金法则
shared_knowledge.body: 画面色彩严格遵循 70% 主导底色（稳住大体量与环境基调）、20% 辅助次色（区分结构层级与透气过渡）、10% 高对比点缀色（仅用于视觉中心与核心识别锚点）；严禁未经授权的高饱和荧光/霓虹杂色乱入破坏色调统一。

winner.prompt: 原图画风优先：保画风与机位，小幅姿态/局部布局；柔化光影与留白层次 | A watercolor storybook mobile-game merge ladder, one horizontal contact sheet on a dark muted wash. Domain is kitchen cookware only. Exactly eight different single kitchen tools in a row, chosen and ordered by an upgrade relation. Soft watercolor, paper texture, warm gentle light, short shadows. Each tool is one object inside its own grid cell. Lower steps are clearly smaller. Each step to the right is a little bigger than the one on its left, so the climb is obvious at a glance, and nothing in the middle shrinks back down. Higher steps stay inside the cell. Left to right the silhouette also gains parts. The rightmost tool is one single object with the most parts, only a little bigger than the one before it, not a whole kitchen and not a pile of tools. Two tools of the same kind must not sit side by side. Neighboring tools must be different kinds. No step may be smaller than the tool on its left. Each cell holds exactly one piece, with no second loose piece beside it. No two neighbors share the same silhouette family. Every cell is a little bigger than the cell on its left. The rightmost item became a pile of several pieces, and one middle step is smaller than the tool on its left. Same-kind neighbors are still side by side. Re-choose eight tools so the rightmost is still one single object, every neighbor is a different kind, and every step is a little bigger. No text, no labels. | 约束：不改机位与镜头视角；不增删主体元素清单；不做整体 recompose / 换景别故事；保持原图画风笔触与色板；保持原图性别、物种、年龄段与核心外观
